name: Approval Reminder
description: Sent to approvers who have not reviewed an assigned approval request after an admin-configured amount of time.
subject: Reminder: An approval request is awaiting your review
body:
Approval request reminder

Dear ${__recipient.name},

This is a reminder that an approval request assigned to you is still awaiting your review.

  • Request: $approvalName
    • #if($requestee.name && $requestee.name != '')
  • Submitted by: $requester.name
  • Requested for: $requestee.name
    • #else
  • Submitted by: $requester.name
    • #end

To review approval requests assigned to you, use the link below.

Review approval requests

Best regards,
The ${__global.productName} Team
